title: UMass Dartmouth football player killed, another injured in Providence stabbing
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Crime Providence Police charged Chukuwnonso Uzoma-eze, another UMass Dartmouth student, with murder ShareSend this article to your social connections.

UMass Dartmouth student is charged with murder following an early Saturday morning stabbing that killed one member of the university’s football team and injured another outside of a Providence nightclub, police said.

Chukuwnonso Uzoma-eze, 19, allegedly killed Marvins Antoine and injured Kensley Macean following an altercation that began in line for the Mezzo Lounge and ended at the Wendy’s parking lot across the street, Providence police announced in a press release.
